items.q: Which publications will carry my story?
items.a: It depends on the story and the package, the network spans 500+ channels, from national dailies to business and industry portals. On the intake call we map the exact outlet mix for your goals, before you pay anything.
Most releases go from first call to live links within 7–14 days, including your review round.

items.q: Do I need to write anything?
items.a: No. You talk for half an hour; we do the writing. You approve the final draft before it goes anywhere.

items.q: Will it show up when people Google me?
items.a: That is the point. Stories are indexed on Google News and rank for your name and brand searches, usually within days of going live.
